contracts.question: 本月各单位中，单位管长漏损量最低的前三家单位和数值是什么？
contracts.sql_template:
SELECT _g."组织" AS "组织", ROUND((_g.unit_loss)::numeric, 4) AS "单位管长漏损量"
FROM (
SELECT COALESCE(l.org, p.org) AS "组织",
       l.loss_vol / NULLIF(p.pipe_len_km * EXTRACT(DAY FROM CAST(:end_date AS date)), 0) AS unit_loss
FROM (
  SELECT CASE bz_bm WHEN '坪地分公司' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN '莲塘分公司' THEN '莲塘供水'
     ELSE bz_bm END AS org, SUM(NULLIF(water_leakage,'')::numeric) AS loss_vol
  FROM dwd_gdgl_gd_gsgdwxmx
  WHERE create_time>=CAST(:start_date AS timestamp) AND create_time<CAST(:next_month_start AS timestamp)
    AND bz_bm IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1
) l
FULL JOIN (
  SELECT CASE dwmc WHEN '光明水务公司' THEN '光明水务集团' WHEN '龙华水务公司' THEN '龙华水务集团'
     WHEN '龙岗坪地供水公司' THEN '坪地供水' WHEN '布吉供水公司' THEN '布吉水司'
     WHEN '莲塘供水公司' THEN '莲塘供水' WHEN '深汕水务公司' THEN '深汕水务'
     ELSE dwmc END AS org, gdcd::numeric AS pipe_len_km
  FROM dm_lszb_tlxl_tj
  WHERE sjsj=(SELECT MAX(sjsj) FROM dm_lszb_tlxl_tj) AND dwmc NOT IN ('本地','其他')
) p ON l.org=p.org
ORDER BY unit_loss ASC NULLS LAST, COALESCE(l.org,p.org) ASC
LIMIT 3
) _g
ORDER BY "单位管长漏损量" ASC NULLS LAST

SELECT _g."组织" AS "组织", CAST(_g.cnt AS bigint) AS "有效DMA数", ROUND((_g.rate)::numeric, 4) AS "有效小区漏损率"
FROM (
SELECT CASE
    WHEN w.bz_bm = '其他' AND w.zonecode LIKE '%%F1014%%' THEN '布吉水司'
    WHEN w.bz_bm = '其他' AND w.zonecode LIKE '%%F1013%%' THEN '莲塘供水'
    WHEN w.bz_bm = '其他' AND w.zonecode LIKE '%%F1009%%' THEN '坪地供水'
    ELSE w.bz_bm
END AS "组织", COUNT(DISTINCT w.dmaid) AS cnt, SUM(physicalloss)/NULLIF(SUM(totalproduct),0) AS rate
FROM dwd_lsxt_wlls w
JOIN dwd_lsxt_dma d ON d.dmaid=w.dmaid AND status='WORK'
WHERE periodtype='Day' AND diffresult='GOOD' AND taskstart::date >= CAST(:start_date AS date) AND taskstart::date < CAST(:next_month_start AS date)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 ASC
) _g
ORDER BY 1 ASC
